task.title: Real task: 3 Facebook posts for The Anonymous Marketer (Niche Blueprint)
task.objective: Create a file named posts.md in the job directory containing exactly 3 Facebook posts for the brand The Anonymous Marketer, which sells the Niche Blueprint (a guide to building a niche online business without showing your face). Order: POST 1 = PAIN (a specific, recognisable problem: having knowledge or an idea but no product structure behind it). POST 2 = VALUE (paraphrase one usable tip: before publishing anything, check it with four questions - can a reader get the point in two minutes, is it specific to one audience, does it give a real usable win, does it sound natural read aloud). POST 3 = PRODUCT (introduce the Niche Blueprint as the step-by-step framework for this; CTA must be 'link in bio'). Each post: hook line, 3-6 short lines, ends with a question. Rules: no URLs, no sales/revenue/traffic/follower numbers, no testimonials, no hype words (game changer, revolutionary, ultimate, unleash, life-changing), gender-neutral wording, direct conversational tone. Label each post with a heading: ## POST 1 PAIN, ## POST 2 VALUE, ## POST 3 PRODUCT.
